lines.speaker: Lebo
lines.source: Whoa! Jabu, look at that tree! Its tummy is bigger than yours!
lines.text: Hawu! Jabu, bheka lesiya sihlahla! Isisu saso sikhulu kunesakho!

lines.speaker: Lebo
lines.source: Okay, okay. Maybe not bigger. But why is the trunk so wide?
lines.text: Kulungile, kulungile. Mhlawumbe asisikhulu. Kodwa kungani isiqu saso sibanzi kangaka?

lines.speaker: Lebo
lines.source: We need berries for our jam. One basket for us, and one little bowl to share.
lines.text: Sidinga amajikijolo ukuze senze ujamu wethu. Ubhasikidi owodwa owethu, nesitsha esincane esisabelana ngaso.

lines.speaker: Lebo
lines.source: Let’s count together. One, two, three, four, five!
lines.text: Asibale ndawonye. Kunye, kubili, kuthathu, kune, kuhlanu!

lines.speaker: Lebo
lines.source: Jabu, your trunk is the fastest berry-picker I’ve ever seen.
lines.text: Jabu, umboko wakho ushesha kakhulu ekukheni amajikijolo!

lines.speaker: Lebo
lines.source: First, bowl. Then berries. Then mash. Then stir. In that order!
lines.text: Okokuqala, isitsha. Bese amajikijolo. Bese siyawachoboza. Bese siyaxova. Ngalowo myalelo!

lines.speaker: Lebo
lines.source: Catch the purple one! No, the other purple one!

lines.speaker: Lebo
lines.source: Well... that did not go to plan.
lines.text: Hhayi bo... lokho akuhambanga ngendlela ebesihlele ngayo.

lines.speaker: Lebo
lines.source: But we can fix it. We’ll pick up, clean up, and try again.
lines.text: Kodwa singakulungisa. Sizocosha, sihlanze, bese sizama futhi.

lines.speaker: Lebo
lines.source: You gather. I sort. Then we both stir.
lines.text: Wena qoqa. Mina ngihlukanise. Bese sixova sobabili.

lines.speaker: Lebo
lines.source: Look! A small pot of jam and a very big adventure.
lines.text: Bheka! Ibhodwe elincane likajamu nohambo olukhulu kakhulu.

lines.speaker: Lebo
lines.source: Baobabs grow in several parts of Africa. Their thick trunks can store lots of water, which helps them through dry times.
lines.text: Izihlahla ze-baobab zikhula ezingxenyeni eziningana zase-Afrika. Iziqu zazo ezinkulu zingagcina amanzi amaningi, okusiza ngesikhathi somiso.

lines.speaker: Lebo
lines.source: Africa is full of different places, people, plants and stories. We’ll discover another one next time.
lines.text: I-Afrika igcwele izindawo, abantu, izitshalo nezindaba ezahlukene. Sizothola okunye ngesikhathi esizayo.
